# Pull request

## Linked issue

Closes #<!-- issue number -->

## Resulting behavior

Describe the problem and resulting behavior, including exclusions.

## Design decisions

Record decisions owned by this PR and link any architectural decision record.
Changes to accepted architecture require owner discussion before implementation.

## Validation

List commands, results, independent expectations, and relevant CI run links.
Include contract examples or UI screenshots when relevant.

## Limitations and compatibility

Describe limitations, migration/recovery/rollback requirements, or explain why
none apply. Do not imply that a code revert reverses persisted state.

## Review readiness

- [ ] Acceptance criteria and documentation are satisfied.
- [ ] Relevant failures and resource limits are tested.
- [ ] No secrets or unreviewed third-party fixtures are included.
- [ ] Owner merge authorization is still required; passing CI is not permission.
